title: The Robert Charles shootout and his escape
summary: Adams tells how police confronted Robert Charles waiting for his wife, shots followed, and he fled upstairs and escaped.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
